targetReport.title: 小企业会计准则 (Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises)
targetReport.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
targetReport.description: The Ministry of Finance's simplified accounting standard for small enterprises, issued as 财会〔2011〕17号 on 2011-10-18 and in force from 2013-01-01, replacing the 2004 小企业会计制度. It sits beside the full 企业会计准则 as the second of the two accounting bases a Chinese enterprise may keep its books under, and that is exactly how statistical yearbooks name it: their 主要统计指标解释 for industrial, real-estate and service-enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 管理费用, 研发费用, 营业利润, 固定资产) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 利润表 or 资产负债表 to take depending on whether the enterprise executes 企业会计准则 or 《小企业会计准则》. The cited page is the Ministry's own 会计司 policy-release page carrying the issuing notice in full. Minted round 42 off three independent yearbook citations (Xi'an, Suzhou, Guangdong) after round 40 opened the lead.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued once in 2011 and effective 2013; not reissued on a cycle.

results.bestSpan: 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业：资产总计=流动资产合计+非流动资产合计
results.window:
资产总计    指企业过去的交易或者事项形成的、由企业拥有或者控制的、预期会给企业带来经济利益的资源。资产
一般按流动性（资产的变现或耗用时间长短）分为流动资产和非流动资产。其中流动资产可分为货币资金、交易性金融
资产、应收票据、应收账款、预付款项、其他应收款、存货等；非流动资产可分为长期股权投资、固定资产、无形资产
及其他非流动资产等。根据会计“资产负债表”中“资产总计”项目的期末余额数填报。 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业：资产总计=流动资产合计+非流动资产合计；执行其他企业会
计制度的企业资产包括流动资产、长期投资、固定资产、无形资产和其他资产等。 流动资产合计    资产满足以下条件之一应归为流动资产：(1)预计在一个正常营业周期中变现、出售或耗用，主要
包括存货、应收账款等；(2)主要为交易目的而持有；(3)预计在资产负债表日起一年内（含一年）变现；(4)自资产负债日
起一年内，交换其他资产或清偿负债的能力不受限制的现金或现金等价物。包括货币资金、应收票据、应收账款、存货
等项目。根据会计“资产负债表”中“流动资产合计”项目的期末余额数填报。

targetReport.title: 企业会计准则——基本准则 (Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises — Basic Standard)
title_aliases: 企业会计准则——基本准则
targetReport.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
targetReport.description: The Ministry of Finance's basic standard at the head of China's enterprise accounting system, promulgated as 财政部令第33号 on 2006-02-15 and in force from 2007-01-01, amended by 财政部令第76号 of 2014-07-23 (article 42(5), the fair-value definition, rewritten for convergence with IFRS). Its article 3 defines the system it heads — 企业会计准则包括基本准则和具体准则，具体准则的制定应当遵循本准则 — so the bare 《企业会计准则》 that statistical yearbooks name is the system, and the basic standard is its node (Thomas ruled 2026-09-10, round 43: one node, the basic standard). It is the full accounting basis beside the simplified 小企业会计准则, and yearbooks name the pair together: their 主要统计指标解释 for enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 固定资产合计, 销售费用, 营业利润) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 资产负债表 or 利润表 to take 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own pages for 令第76号 (tfs.mof.gov.cn/caizhengbuling/201407/t20140729_1119494.htm) and for the 2006 issue on kjs.mof.gov.cn answered 502 from the Ministry's CDN to the cloud container and to the built-in browser pane on 2026-09-10 (the kjs.mof.gov.cn page cited by cn-mof-small-enterprise-accounting-standards, read fine in round 42, 502'd the same way), so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第76号 with the amended 基本准则 in full (国务院公报 2014年第31号 on gov.cn) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations and cn-mee-hazardous-waste-list-2016; move the URL to the Ministry's page when it answers. MATCHER NOTE: the alias 企业会计准则 is a substring of 小企业会计准则, so a document naming only the small-enterprise standard would also satisfy namesTarget for this node — every edge here quotes a sentence naming both, and a future edge should do the same. Minted round 43 off three independent yearbook citations (Suzhou, Guangdong, Xi'an) after round 40 opened the lead.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued 2006 and amended once in 2014; not reissued on a cycle. The 42 specific standards beneath it are separate instruments.
